items.title: File Adams County business personal property return
items.description: Colorado businesses return the personal property declaration schedule (DS 056) for taxable personal property owned on January 1 to the county assessor by April 15; the filing threshold is a total actual value per county (about $56,000 on recent forms; check the current form). A 10- or 20-day extension costs $20 or $40 if requested by April 15; a late filing penalty is the lesser of $50 or 15% of the tax. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state rule applies. The link is the state Division of Property Taxation page.
